_about: ZONE5 v1 (laneZONE5): per-zone ground option + raycast row snap, read by ZoneRowGround.cs. zones[] = one row per zone that owns a hand-made layout: root = the zone root object, prefix = the row id prefix, floor = "earth" (dark cracked ground: no flagstone row in its layout, crack decals instead) or "paving", skipLibraries = libraries this zone does NOT copy (the span checker honours it per zone instead of the global zone_plan rules.skipLibraries). A ring that is switched on has its wrappers moved to the first non-prop, non-character collider under them (ray from y + rayUpM, rayDownM long, hit within maxDeltaM of the row y); no hit = the row y stays. Ships enabled=false; --on in apply_zone5.py flips it. Args -zonerowground:1|0. Log lines: ZONEROWGROUND <zone> root ... rows, one per snapped row, and all n rows processed.
